days.title: Text → logits → probabilities
days.core: Build the numerical atoms of an autoregressive language model and trace one next-token prediction end to end.
days.floor: Compute one three-logit softmax by hand, implement stable_softmax, and write 150 words explaining logits versus probabilities.

days.title: Build a byte-level BPE tokenizer
days.core: Understand how raw text becomes the discrete sequence the transformer actually sees.
days.floor: Implement UTF-8 byte encode/decode round-trip and manually perform three BPE merges on one short string.

days.title: Attention by hand
days.core: Implement single-head causal self-attention and explain information routing precisely.
days.floor: Calculate one attention row by hand and implement the score, mask and softmax portion of scaled_dot_product_attention.

days.title: Build the transformer block
days.core: Assemble multi-head attention, residual pathways, RMSNorm, RoPE and SwiGLU into one decoder block.
days.floor: Implement RMSNorm and one residual sublayer, then explain why the residual path protects information flow.

days.title: Assemble a mini-GPT
days.core: Build the complete decoder-only forward pass from token IDs to next-token logits.
days.floor: Wire embeddings → one block → final norm → logits and pass the output-shape test.

days.title: Make the model learn
days.core: Understand how prediction error becomes weight change and prove the full training path by overfitting one batch.
days.floor: Make loss fall on a two-parameter toy problem and derive the first Adam update by hand.

days.title: Train, sample and explain generation
days.core: Train the mini-GPT on a small corpus and separate learned logits from decoding behaviour.
days.floor: Implement greedy and temperature sampling, generate two contrasting samples, and explain why the weights were unchanged.

days.title: Diagnose behaviour without storytelling
days.core: Learn the seven-layer diagnostic stack and apply it to controlled failure cases.
days.floor: Diagnose three cases using the seven-layer stack and propose one intervention for each.

days.title: See inside: activations and the logit lens
days.core: Use hooks and cached activations to locate where output-relevant information becomes decodable.
days.floor: Load one supported model, cache residual activations, record their shapes, and compute one layer-wise target logit.

days.title: Causal tracing with activation patching
days.core: Replace internal activations between clean and corrupted runs to identify causally important locations.
days.floor: Patch residual state at one layer across five aligned clean/corrupted pairs and compute the change in logit difference.

days.title: From locations to circuits
days.core: Narrow a behaviour from layer/position localization to attention-head and MLP components using ablation and path hypotheses.
days.floor: Rank all heads in one small model by one ablation metric and explain the top three without claiming completeness.

days.title: How post-training reshapes behaviour
days.core: Separate pretraining capability from assistant behaviour by understanding SFT and preference optimization.
days.floor: Implement and test dpo_loss on scalar log-probabilities, then compare five prompts across a base/instruction pair.

days.title: Run an original mini-study
days.core: Convert one observed LLM behaviour into a falsifiable, controlled and causally probed research question.
days.floor: Define one behaviour precisely, write two competing hypotheses, construct ten examples and run one discriminating behavioural intervention.

days.title: Final defense and mechanism atlas
days.core: Demonstrate closed-book command of the complete stack and convert the sprint into a durable research system.
days.floor: Complete the closed-book forward-pass derivation, diagnose one unseen case, and write the next research question with two hypotheses.
